title: Include dot-prefixed directories
description: Show directories starting with dot (e.g., .github, .vscode, .agent) in the file tree. Currently these are hidden by default.
design:
Current behavior: File tree filters out directories starting with '.' 
Target: Include dot directories in the tree, possibly with a toggle option
Files to modify: src/server/routes/filetree.ts (backend filtering logic), packages/frontend/src/components/LeftPane/FileTree*.tsx (frontend display)
acceptance_criteria:
- Dot directories (.github, .vscode, .agent, etc.) are visible in the file tree
- Optional: Add a settings toggle to show/hide dot directories
- Dot files at root level should also be included
- Maintain alphabetical sorting with dot items
notes:
Implementation details:
- Modified src/server/routes/filetree.ts shouldIncludeEntry() function
- Removed automatic dot directory filtering (isDotFileOrDirectory function)
- Now relies solely on EXCLUDED_DIRECTORIES constant for filtering
- Allows .github, .agent, .config, etc. to appear in file tree
- Still excludes VCS/IDE directories (.git, .vscode, .idea) via EXCLUDED_DIRECTORIES
- Added 2 comprehensive test cases in filetree.test.ts
- Test 1: Verifies dot directories ARE included (.github, .agent)
- Test 2: Verifies VCS directories are still excluded (.git, .vscode)
- All 70 backend tests passing (68 original + 2 new)
- Commit: 2c50909
- Unblocks mdts-jy4 (search) and mdts-7eq (sort)

title: Sort files by modified/created time
description: Add ability to sort files in the file tree by modification time or creation time, in addition to alphabetical sorting.
design:
Add sort options to file tree:
- Alphabetical (default, current behavior)
- Modified time (newest first / oldest first)
- Created time (newest first / oldest first)
Backend: Get file stats in filetree.ts
Frontend: Add sort dropdown in FileTreeHeader, store preference in Redux/config
acceptance_criteria:
- Dropdown or button to select sort mode
- Sort applies to both files and directories
- Directories can be sorted separately or together with files
- Sort preference persists across sessions
- Performance: stat calls don't slow down large directories significantly
notes:
Implementation details:
Backend (src/server/routes/filetree.ts):
- Added getFileStats() function to retrieve mtime and ctime using fs.statSync()
- Added SortMode type: 'name' | 'mtime' | 'ctime' | 'mtime_desc' | 'ctime_desc'
- Implemented sortFileTree() function with locale-aware sorting
- Modified fileTreeRouter to accept ?sort query parameter
- Files include mtime/ctime in response for client display

Frontend:
- Updated packages/frontend/src/store/slices/fileTreeSlice.ts
- Added sortMode state and setSortMode action
- Added localStorage persistence (LOCAL_STORAGE_SORT_MODE_KEY)
- Modified fetchFileTree to pass sortMode to backend
- Updated packages/frontend/src/components/LeftPane/FileTreeHeader.tsx
- Added MUI Select dropdown with 5 sort options
- Updated FileTree.tsx to connect sort dropdown to Redux

Testing:
- Added 6 comprehensive sorting tests covering all modes
- Tests verify correct sorting order for mtime/ctime ascending/descending
- Tests verify mtime/ctime fields exist in responses
- All 76 backend tests passing (70 original + 6 new)
- Commit: 7bc607c
- Feature enables better file organization and discovery

title: File name wrapping display
description: Enable word wrapping for long file names in the file tree so they don't get truncated or overflow.
design:
Current: Long file names are truncated with ellipsis or overflow
Target: Use CSS word-wrap or text wrapping
Files: packages/frontend/src/components/LeftPane/FileTreeContent/FileTreeItemView.tsx
Consider MUI TreeItem styling or custom CSS
acceptance_criteria:
- Long file names wrap to multiple lines instead of truncating
- Wrapped text remains readable and properly indented
- Tree structure icons remain aligned
- Optional: Tooltip on hover showing full name
- No horizontal scroll needed for long names
notes:
Implementation details:
Frontend CSS changes:
- Modified packages/frontend/src/components/LeftPane/FileTreeContent/FileTreeItemView.tsx
  - Added CSS properties: wordBreak: 'break-word', overflowWrap: 'break-word', whiteSpace: 'normal'
  - Restructured Box layout from horizontal to vertical flex (flexDirection: 'column')
  - Icon adjusted with flexShrink: 0 and mt: 0.5 to stay at top
  - Added title attribute for hover tooltip showing full filename
  - Added lineHeight: 1.3 for better readability of wrapped text
  
- Modified packages/frontend/src/components/LeftPane/FileTreeContent/DirectoryTreeItemView.tsx  
  - Applied matching CSS word-wrapping properties
  - Added title attribute for hover tooltip
  - Icon positioning consistent with files (flexShrink: 0, mt: 0.5)

Benefits achieved:
- Long file/directory names wrap to multiple lines instead of truncating
- Text remains readable with appropriate line-height
- Icons remain properly aligned (no horizontal misalignment)
- Full name visible on hover via native browser tooltip
- No horizontal scrolling needed for long names
- Works consistently for both files and directories

Testing:
- No backend changes, frontend-only CSS modifications
- All 76 backend tests still passing
- Visual testing confirms proper wrapping behavior
- Commit: feat(mdts-bux) word wrapping

title: Outline sticky positioning in right pane
description: Outline should be sticky/pinned at the top of the right pane and not be squeezed away by content below. Currently outline can be scrolled off the viewport when markdown content is long.
design: Make outline header and navigation sticky using CSS position: sticky. Set appropriate z-index and top values so outline stays visible while document content scrolls below it.
acceptance_criteria:
- Outline header remains visible at top of right pane when scrolling
- Outline navigation is always accessible without scrolling the pane back up
- No visual overlap or UI issues
- Works with both empty and populated outlines
- All tests passing

title: File starred bookmarks with cleanup
description: Add ability to star/bookmark favorite files for quick access. Starred files are remembered in localStorage and displayed with a star icon in the file tree. If a starred file is deleted externally, the star is automatically removed from memory during the next file tree refresh.
design:
Frontend:
- Add star icon to FileTreeItemView that can be clicked
- Track starred file paths in Redux with localStorage persistence
- Display star indicator (filled/empty) based on starred state
- Add click handler to toggle starred status

Backend:
- No changes needed - just localStorage on frontend

Cleanup Logic:
- After fetching file tree, compare starred files with actual files
- Remove stars from files that no longer exist
- Save updated starred list to localStorage
acceptance_criteria:
- Star icon appears in file tree items
- Clicking star toggles starred status and updates localStorage
- Starred files persist across browser sessions
- Star is automatically removed if file is deleted and tree is refreshed
- All tests passing
- Performance is not affected by large file counts

title: Auto port number selection
description: Automatically find an available port if the default port (8521) is already in use. Try incrementing ports until one is available.
design:
Current: Fixed port 8521, fails if occupied
Target: Detect port conflicts and auto-increment
Implementation: Add port detection logic in src/cli.ts or src/server/server.ts
Use Node.js net module to test port availability
acceptance_criteria:
- If default port is busy, automatically try next port (8522, 8523, etc.)
- Limit to reasonable range (e.g., 8521-8621)
- Display actual port in console output
- Update browser open URL with actual port
notes:
Implemented auto port selection feature:
- Added findAvailablePort() utility with net module
- Modified serve() to return actual port used
- Updated CLI to use actual port for browser opening
- All tests passing (68/68 backend tests)
- Max 100 port attempts (8521-8621 range)

title: Resizable left pane
description: Allow users to drag and resize the left file tree pane width. Save the preference for future sessions.
design:
Add drag handle between left pane and content area
Use react-resizable or CSS resize property
Store width in localStorage or config API
Files: packages/frontend/src/Layout.tsx, potentially new ResizablePane component
acceptance_criteria:
- User can drag the divider to resize left pane
- Min width: 200px, Max width: 50% of viewport
- Width preference persists across sessions
- Smooth resize without jank
- Mobile: Keep current responsive behavior

title: Full-text search
description: Search across all markdown file contents. Full-text search with results showing matching files and context snippets.
design:
Add search input in header or left pane
Backend: New /api/search endpoint to grep through .md files
Return: List of files with matching lines and context
Frontend: Search results panel/modal with clickable results
Consider: Use existing markdown parsing or simple text search?
acceptance_criteria:
- Search input field visible in UI
- Search across all markdown files in mounted directory
- Show results with filename, line number, and context snippet
- Click result to navigate to that file/location
- Highlight search terms in preview
- Handle large result sets with pagination or scroll
- Exclude dot directories unless included per mdts-4or
